candidates.excerpt: The EAGLE Force and TG SAFE inspected four medical establishments in Hyderabad and found alleged deficiencies in mandatory drug registers, sale bills and records. Show-cause notices were issued to all four establishments, with further action expected under applicable provisions.

candidates.title: Expert at proving lies as truth: Delhi PWD Minister blames AAP as police flag Barapullah Phase-III errors
candidates.excerpt: The Barapullah Phase-III stretch, which was opened last month, has witnessed slow-moving traffic and congestion due to several design-related shortcomings.

candidates.excerpt: Rahul Gandhi backing vote chor says KTR as Congress leads vote chori protest

candidates.title: Hyderabad property sold and mortgaged repeatedly, cheating 54 people of Rs 4.5 crore
candidates.excerpt: The CCS has urged the public to exercise caution while entering into property transactions, particularly when offered unusually high financial returns within a short period

candidates.title: Delhi HC directs govt to decide in 6 months on SOP for body cameras for police, RAF
candidates.excerpt: The Delhi High Court on Wednesday directed the government to treat a public interest litigation (PIL) seeking mandatory use of body-worn cameras by Delhi Police and Rapid Action Force (RAF) personnel deployed for crowd control and protest management duties as a representation.

candidates.title: Hyderabad police form special teams to probe Rs 4.50-cr property fraud
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad police have formed special teams to investigate an alleged Rs 4.50-crore property fraud involving 54 victims. The case concerns multiple sale and mortgage agreements executed for the same property in Madannapet, with the prime suspects currently absconding

candidates.title: AAP stages protest outside Delhi Chief Electoral Officer’s office; Cong, Left parties join
candidates.excerpt: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) on Wednesday staged a protest outside the Delhi Chief Electoral Officer’s office at Kashmere Gate, with Left parties and the Congress also joining the demonstration against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar.

candidates.title: Israelis mark three years since Hamas attack that set off Gaza assault
candidates.excerpt: The anniversary is the first for Israelis without any hostages still held in Gaza, ⁠with those dead and alive exchanged in swaps with Hamas for Palestinians held in Israeli jails. The remains of the last Israeli hostage were recovered in January

candidates.title: Pakistan security forces kill 18 terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan
candidates.excerpt: According to Radio Pakistan, the security forces “killed 13 Fitna al-Khawarij terrorists” during an intelligence-based operation in North Waziristan district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

candidates.title: 7 policemen injured in attack in northwest Pakistan
candidates.excerpt: A search operation has been launched, and an investigation into the incident is underway

candidates.title: Ex-Telangana home guard working as bike-taxi driver in Andhra held in chain-snatching case
candidates.excerpt: Police say he used the job to move around and target women walking alone in six cities; a woman who allegedly sold the jewellery is also arrested

candidates.title: Bandi Sanjay’s son moves Telangana HC to restrain media, social platforms over POCSO case
candidates.excerpt: Bandi Sai Bhageerath, son of Union Minister Bandi Sanjay Kumar, has approached the Telangana High Court seeking directions to media outlets and social media platforms to restrain circulation of content relating to a POCSO case registered against him.
